race.comment: IL PASSERO (2) was a month between runs before his latest effort, a handy fifth in a 1200m BM84 at Randwick. Drops in grade this evening and should tighten right up following that last hit-out. Perfectly placed back in midweek company at the fourth run back, and McDonald in the irons won't harm his chances. STEEL MOVE (3) wasn't suited dropping back to 1100m at Warwick Farm last time out when second-up from a spell, but he did a fair job to be beaten just over three lengths. Back up to his right trip at the third run back. MAWJOOD (1) was in the betting but didn't raise backers' hopes at any stage when resuming over 1300m at Randwick recently. Won't find this as tough and the second-up record is solid. Can improve sharply. MAILATA (11) had no luck in the run so his effort to be beaten just 2.7 lengths over 1200m at Rosehill last start had merit. Ready to find peak form at the fourth run back. IVAN'S HERO (9) is a chance back in Sydney off an eight-week let-up.
